added_after: All primary summary/mean/count outcomes and the common-shift diagnostic were known. Explicit exploratory corrective test, not blind validation.
case_rule: All44 original raw mean cases and identical first4 count cases/context; complete300 predicted targets used for centering, never center only scored cases. Same inputs, seeds and emitter.
hypothesis: Protect target discrimination: target-centered residual removes target-shared drift; genuine-minus-shuffled residual retains response-retrieval dependence. Fixed quarter strength, no grid.
select_rule: Prefer a contrast passing expression<=1.02*V24,FID>=V24-.02,PDS>=V24-.02,NMAE<=1.01*V24 and mean MSE/MAE<=1.002, with at least one of mean MSE/MAE/DE metrics improved. Select smallest raw mean MSE among passing contrasts and a currently selected candidate if it passes the same count/mean limits. If none passes, retain current exploratory selection. Strict primary improvement/confirmation flags unchanged.
